create_DINOv3ViTImageProcessor: create a DINOv3ViTImageProcessor instance with default image mean, std, size 224x224, bilinear resampling
run_image_preprocess: run the _preprocess method on a list of torch tensors with resize, rescale, and normalize transforms
build_image_batch_processor: build an image batch processor that groups images by shape, rescales, resizes with antialias, and normalizes with ImageNet stats
test_image_processor_resize: test the DINOv3ViTImageProcessor resize and rescale pipeline with configurable size and bilinear resampling
review_image_normalization: review the DINOv3ViTImageProcessor normalize step that applies ImageNet mean and standard deviation to pixel values
